description: 3D Pareto front scatter from NSGA-III on DTLZ2 with 3 objectives.
ground_truth_reason: The standalone example defines or configures an objective and invokes a population-based optimizer with a bounded generation/epoch parameter. Candidate solutions are scored, compared/selected, varied, and updated through the optimizer. Crossover is marked true only for GA/NSGA-II or explicit SHADE/BBO recombination cases; otherwise no two-parent offspring operation is established in this source. Safety expectation remains UNKNOWN because these legacy examples have not been individually adjudicated against all enabled safety-policy conditions.
